notes: Sourced from Kramer's official technical specification PDF (k.kramerav.com), the authoritative manufacturer document, cross-checked against Kramer's current product page (www1.kramerav.com/product/tp-580t). This is an HDBaseT transmitter (paired with a TP-580R receiver) extending one HDMI input plus bidirectional RS-232 and IR over a single RJ-45/CAT cable, up to 70m/230ft. It is a compact desktop enclosure (12.0 x 7.2 x 2.4 cm, 0.6kg) — not inherently rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted; Kramer's optional RK-3T adapter lets three units share 1U space. HDMI grade (2.0) is inferred: the spec PDF states 10.2Gbps max data rate (3.4Gbps per graphic channel) and "Supports HDMI and HDCP," while the current manufacturer product page title/description states "4K60 4:2:0 HDMI HDCP 2.2" support, both consistent with HDMI 2.0 rather than 1.4 or 2.1. No RS-232/IR grade applies (control/analog signals, not bandwidth-graded). Category set to "converter" and type "Extender" since this is a point-to-point HDBaseT signal extender, not a matrix/switcher.

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Supports HDCP 2.2 and 4K@60Hz (4:2:0); max data rate 10.2Gbps (3.4Gbps per graphic channel) per manufacturer spec, consistent with HDMI 2.0 signal compliance stated on the current product page.

ports.name: HDBT
ports.note: HDBaseT twisted-pair output carrying HDMI, RS-232 and IR to a paired TP-580R receiver over CAT cable (up to 70m/230ft); not a standard Ethernet data port so no eth-* grade assigned.

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 9-pin D-sub, bidirectional pass-through for serial control/data extension and firmware upgrade; baud rate 115200.

ports.name: IR
ports.note: 3.5mm mini jack for IR link extension, pass-through to/from the paired TP-580R.

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: External power supply (included accessory); power consumption 12V DC, 275mA.
